safetyRationale: The HTML defines no complete ENC depth-area palette. Explicit additional shades retain the pinned deep/medium/shallow/very-shallow/intertidal distinctions; safety contour and safety soundings remain distinct. Day CHBLK retains pinned dark ink for shallow-area contrast. Dusk uses prototype floating text and Night uses prototype chart text for general monochrome ink against the new backgrounds. Symbol geometry, lookups, chromatic buoy/light roles and conditional symbology are unchanged; baked raster sprites are unchanged and need separate contrast review. Native real-ENC hazard review is mandatory before acceptance.
